title: Editorial data spread
slide_intent: Give data rows a consistent visual rhythm, because readers need to follow information across a wide spread.
strategic_value: Broad color bands can carry Channel 4’s palette into formal reporting while separating adjacent rows.
demonstration: An open printed spread carries a sequence of horizontal color bands across both pages, with small labels and values aligned within them and a small 4 near the upper left.
practical_value: Evaluate whether color bands help track a row across the gutter without overwhelming its labels.

content_islands.name: Row structure
content_islands.spec: Run the colored bands horizontally across the open spread with labels and values retained within each row.

content_islands.name: Page signature
content_islands.spec: Keep the small 4 at the upper-left margin.

content_islands.name: Printed view
content_islands.spec: Retain the page curvature and gutter so the reader can assess the design as a printed spread rather than a flat palette.

reference_purposes.Expression: An open printed spread carries a sequence of horizontal color bands across both pages, with small labels and values aligned within them and a small 4 near the upper left.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates this treatment in a printed data spread.
